name: Higashiyoshino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashiyoshino village emblem in blue: a disc bearing white stylised letters h and y.
history: Municipal flag of Higashiyoshino, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1974.

features.role: Higashiyoshino village emblem — a disc bearing white stylised letters h and y
